content_md:
[Pablo Sabbatella and Isaac Patka with Laura Shin](https://unchainedcrypto.com/podcast/how-crypto-users-get-rekt-and-how-you-can-stay-safe/) shared an evergreen conversation, densely packed with practical usefulness and wisdom.

A few years ago, the nicest thing you could do for somebody was gift a hardware wallet for Christmas. It could have been a life changing gift! In 2025, it's pretty clear that would be like gifting a gun without firearms training.

The *Bankless Frontier* is no longer made up of self-sovereign self-sufficient cipherchads (Lewis + Clark explorer-heroes). It feels more like miserable, unwashed masses of pre-wealthy, *i.e.*, poor, economic refugees fleeing city-slums and unfettered capitalism, like the farmer-settlers of [Seven Samurai](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0047478/) and [The Magnificent Seven](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2404435/), providing sustenance for lawless banditos and DPRK hackers.

![Akira Kurosawa on the set of SEVEN SAMURAI film](https://www.highonfilms.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/Akira-Kurosawa-on-the-set-of-SEVEN-SAMURAI-film.jpg)

Next: the Institutions Are Coming, basically, US Marshals bringing the Law, to civilize and tame the Wild West.

---

# I've tipped over into believing

1. DeFi is too complex to secure
